newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: India awards Bombay naphtha to Vitol at USGC-$28/T.
newsitem.headline: India awards Bombay naphtha to Vitol at USGC-$28/T.

text.p: State-owned Indian Oil Corp (IOC) has awarded its tender to sell a 27,000 tonnes of August high aromatic naphtha (HAN) from Bombay to Dutch trader Vitol at around $28 per tonne below U.S. Gulf Coast 87-octane gasoline quotes on a free-on-board (fob) basis, industry sources said on Monday.
The tender which offered the cargo from the west coast between August 3-5, closed July 24 and was valid for one day.
In its last Bombay HAN tender, IOC sold a July 2-4 lifting cargo at around $30 per tonne discount to Japanese spot quotes, fob.
